name: Cassava-leaf soup
summary: The same Jrai cassava leaf, stir-fried and then loosened with rice-flour water until it sets like a porridge. The Vietnam National Authority of Tourism separates this soup from Anam Tbung.
origin: The Krông Pa cassava-leaf article names canh lá mì as a second dish from the leaf the Jrai already stir-fry.
howToEat: Stir-fry the leaves until cooked, then pour in rice-flour water and stir until the flour cooks and thickens like porridge.
where: The article’s kitchen is Jrai, in Krông Pa. A street is Check on arrival. An hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Canh lá mì is stir-fried cassava leaf loosened with rice-flour water until it thickens. A Krông Pa Jrai dish. A price is Check on arrival.
